subject: Request: Out-of-band comp + sign-on for Senior ML Engineer (S. Green)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate: Samantha Green — request for comp exception and sign-on

Hi Aditya,

Following up on our onsite yesterday — Samantha Green (senior ML eng, ex-Scale AI) is a strong match for the distributed training/core-ops role. She gave excellent whiteboard and system design responses and would be a big immediate lift for the team.

Ask: she is asking for an out-of-band base of $250,000 (target role band: $200k-$220k) plus a one-time sign-on of $35,000 to cover relocation and counter-offer risk. Additionally, she requested a one-time equity refresh of 10k RSUs vested over 2 years to make the overall package competitive.

Rationale: rare skillset (LLM model ops at scale), immediate productivity, multiple competing offers expected (engineering manager at competitor has already reached out). If we can approve the exception, I will send the formal offer and aim to close this week.

Attachments: comp_exception_request.pdf (summary + comps), comp_matrix_q3.xlsx

Next steps: could you advise whether you want me to escalate to Laura for comp committee sign-off, or should I loop Legal/Finance now? I can prepare a short justification memo.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0122

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Candidate: Samantha Green — request for comp exception and sign-on

Vivek, Laura — forwarding Monica's note. Quick context: Samantha would report into my org, ramp very quickly, and is effectively replacing two mid-level hires we deferred. I am recommending we approve: base $245k, sign-on $30k, equity refresh 8k RSUs (one-time).

Impact: this is ~12% headcount-equivalent uplift vs plan but will avoid a 3–4 month recruiting cycle and deliver immediate project velocity on the infra effort. We have room in hiring budget this quarter if we take the headcount hit now.

Please advise; if you approve, Monica will send the offer and Legal will route the comp exception docs.

--
Aditya Rao
Director, ML Platforms | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

Thanks for the clear context and the attachment, Monica. I reviewed the comp matrix and Samantha's experience notes. Given the strategic impact and competitive market for infra/LLM ops talent right now, I approve a one-time exception with the following limits:

- Approved base: up to $248,000 (one-time exception for this role)
- One-time sign-on: $30,000 (taxable cash)
- Equity refresh: 8,000 RSUs (one-time grant, accelerated 25% first year, remainder over year two)

Conditions:
- Offer letter must state the exception is a one-time sign-on/refresher and not a change to the role banding.
- Compensation will be reviewed in the next salary band refresh cycle (Q1 2027).
- Finance should be looped for budget coding (please attach to HR-REQ-4982).

Monica — please proceed to issue the offer letter draft (attached) and route to Legal for final review. Aditya — please confirm you are aligned with the approved numbers and the ramp expectations.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
